headings.text: Saiba por que sua máquina parou, antes que a parada vire prejuízo.
O dado já existe. Só não chega até você.
A parada é anotada à mão, atrasada e sem causa. Nós levamos o dado do CLP ao celular de quem decide.
Só lemos o CLP. Nunca escrevemos.
Pare de estimar. Comece a medir.

findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (20px, 1022px, 519px, 42px, 752px, 60px, 76px); the three most used hold only 53% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 985px of nothing between: "Pare de estimar. Comece a medir."
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
